specs.title: the stored G30 is a display: a missing value is empty, never 0, and Save waits for a known basis
Use Current Position fills the draft and writes nothing; Save is one set_g30 on its basis, shown only as confirmed
a save LinuxCNC did not confirm is never 'saved'
machine frame only: under TCP, Use Current Position and Save are dimmed with the reason
a captured draft is dropped when the kinematics mode changes
a save's confirmation never replaces an entry typed while it was out
a capture answered after the frame changed takes nothing over
a capture answered after the draft was edited takes nothing over; a refresh keeps a newer entry
a late file read never overwrites a newer confirmed read
Use Current Position is dimmed while the machine moves, with the gateway's reason
a file read answered after a reconnect supplies no basis; the reconnect reads G30 again
Discard puts the draft back to the stored values and writes nothing
Discard waits for a sent save; the save's outcome is shown
a save with no answer keeps Discard closed until it ends, then says it is not confirmed
Discard while a capture is out: the capture takes nothing over
Refresh keeps an entry typed BEFORE it (machine day F17)
Outside: a held probe button sends its routine with the panel's numbers
Boss/Pocket: a held probe button sends its routine with the panel's numbers
Ridge/Valley: a held probe button sends its routine with the panel's numbers
Angle: a held probe button sends its routine with the panel's numbers
Calibrate: a held probe button sends its routine with the panel's numbers
Surface: a held Start Scan sends the surface_scan_run job with the panel's numbers
z_surface: the job the button sends is the native stage's whole job
surface_scan: the job the button sends is the native stage's whole job
Calibrate: "Round hole — edge start" is named for its start and sends probe_cal_round_pocket
Calibrate: "Round boss — above centre" is named for its start and sends probe_cal_round_boss
Calibrate: "Rect pocket — edge start" is named for its start and sends probe_cal_square_pocket
Calibrate: "Rect boss — above centre" is named for its start and sends probe_cal_square_boss
Boss/Pocket: a boss needs its size; a pocket at 0 says its limited search
R437 capture can be discarded even when its starting draft was clean

specs.title: R437 pocket hint timing before and after activation
a program loads in E-Stop, off and unhomed: programLoad, no power or homing (BG-03)
the task mode per target: MANUAL in E-Stop and unhomed, MDI / AUTO dimmed with the reason; the checked mode sends nothing (BG-04)
E-Stop Reset not confirmed: said at the Reset button
E-Stop Reset unknown: said at the Reset button
E-Stop Reset no reply: said at the Reset button
E-Stop Reset confirmed: said at the Reset button
the recovery order: E-Stop Reset and arming wait for the trip's acknowledgement — the reason at the button (BG-11)
the G30 read: open with the machine off, closed ON in AUTO with the reason (BG-13)
the manual spindle unhomed where the machine declares it, MANUAL only (Q1)
Start by the shortcut waits for the program text like the button (one admission, BG-10)
a save sends the row the dialog opened on — not a newer read
a conflict keeps the dialog, its draft and says why
a renumber sends the row it was opened on too
a hover card closes with its tab
a hover still waiting for its 300 ms never opens after the tab was left
a tapped card closes on a press outside its row and on a scroll
the tab alone closes the card (no scroll, no press, no hover)
